name: Village Square
description: The heart of the village. Marcus's house is on the north side.

name: Marcus Bell's House
description: A large Georgian house on the square's north side. Ground floor has a sitting room with a fireside armchair where Marcus is found. The kitchen is where the cocoa was prepared.

name: Marcus's Study
description: A book-lined study behind the sitting room. Contains the estate papers, the old family photograph, and the solicitor's draft will. The fireplace shows recent ash.

name: Ruth's Cottage
description: Ruth's small cottage on the far side of the square. The garden has a large stand of foxglove — digitalis purpurea.

name: Reed & Bell Bookshop
description: Isabella's bookshop. A key location for motive — Marcus was revising his will to redirect her shares.

name: Village Clinic
description: Nadia's clinic. Marcus was a patient. His medical records show his cardiac history.

name: Whittle & Cross Solicitors
description: The solicitor's office on the edge of the village. Mr. Whittle holds the new will.

name: Priya's Flat
description: Priya's flat, two streets from the square.
